enemy:beast:vampire.description: can transform into a flying bat to flee injury or cross gaps
enemy:beast:vampire.name: Vampire Form: becomes a red Cave Bat to flee injury or cross gaps

enemy:beast:lifesteal.name: Life Drain: heals from damage dealt

enemy:beast:fire-breath.description: can breathe a cone of fire that inflicts Burning
enemy:beast:fire-breath.name: Fire Breath: projects a damaging stream of fire

enemy:beast:bloodmancy.description: can alternate pulling prey one tile closer with inflicting Hemophilia
enemy:beast:bloodmancy.name: Bloodmancy: wrests a victim one square and inflicts hemophilia

enemy:beast:inventor.description: flees toward its linked dormant mech and climbs inside
enemy:beast:inventor.name: Mech Pilot: flees toward a dormant Hemogoblin Mech and climbs inside

enemy:beast:mech.description: needs a pilot before it can move or attack
enemy:beast:mech.name: Dormant Machine: activates only with an inventor aboard; destruction leaves the pilot's corpse

enemy:beast:regeneration.description: regenerates wounds unusually quickly each normal turn
enemy:beast:regeneration.name: Rapid Regeneration: heals wounds each normal turn

enemy:beast:witch.description: can cycle through inflicting Slowed, Hemophilia and Poisoned
enemy:beast:witch.name: Witchcraft: inflicts slowness, hemophilia and poison while fleeing

enemy:beast:minotaur.description: commits to its displayed direction before choosing another, even when blocked
enemy:beast:minotaur.name: Committed Charge: follows its displayed arrow for two moves before choosing again

enemy:beast:wendigo.description: feeds on previously uneaten corpses to grow stronger and delay their revival, and flees while injured
enemy:beast:wendigo.name: Corpse Feast: each unique corpse grants +5 Offense and Defense, up to level five; resets that corpse's revival countdown

enemy:beast:banshee.description: periodically reveals its location with a shriek that damages you through armor when it can see you
enemy:beast:banshee.name: Banshee Shriek: every 30 turns, reveals its location and deals 100 damage through DR to the player within its line of sight

enemy:beast:sphinx.description: is invulnerable and waits after being attacked before hunting its attacker
enemy:beast:sphinx.name: Invincible Guardian: waits three turns after being attacked before hunting

enemy:beast:deep-water.description: can hold adjacent prey in place, but only in deep water
enemy:beast:deep-water.name: Deep-Water Grasp: seizes victims only in deep water

enemy:beast:yeti.description: inflicts Slowed when either of your bodies starts a turn adjacent to it
enemy:beast:yeti.name: Winter's Trail: leaves cosmetic snow and slows you when either of your bodies starts a turn adjacent

enemy:beast:phoenix.description: revives at full health, with each failed revival doubling its next revival chance
enemy:beast:phoenix.name: Phoenix Rebirth: failed revival rolls double its next chance; revives at full health

enemy:beast:dryad.description: can heal an injured ally within sight
enemy:beast:dryad.name: Healing Grove: heals nearby allies while fleeing the player

enemy:beast:armor-piercing.name: Crushing Claws: attacks bypass damage reduction

enemy:beast:ursa-minor.description: wakes its linked companion and calls it to the death site when it dies
enemy:beast:ursa-minor.name: Star-Bear's Death Cry: wakes its paired Ursa Major and calls it to the death site

enemy:beast:ursa-major.description: can be awakened by its linked companion’s death cry
enemy:beast:ursa-major.name: Sleeping Star-Bear: wakes to its companion's death cry and investigates that location

enemy:beast:ichor-siphon.description: heals on successful hits while standing in ichor
enemy:beast:ichor-siphon.name: Ichor Siphon: successful hits in ichor heal 2% maximum health

enemy:beast:fungal-gas.description: emits gas and feeds on visible nearby corpses through roots, preventing their revival while connected
enemy:beast:fungal-gas.name: Fungal gas: roots feed on corpses within sight and 10 tiles

enemy:beast:gas-immunity.description: is immune to gases and gas explosions
enemy:beast:gas-immunity.name: Gas Immunity: ignores all gases and gas explosions; Bastidion can still catch fire

enemy:beast:no-revival.description: never revives, though its remains can feed fungal roots
enemy:beast:no-revival.name: Final Death: never revives; its remains can feed fungal roots

enemy:beast:slow.description: acts only every other normal turn
enemy:beast:slow.name: Slow (acts every other turn)

enemy:beast:fast.description: takes an extra movement step each turn
enemy:beast:fast.name: Fast (extra movement step)

enemy:beast:slime-trail.description: coats adjacent ground with green slime when it moves
enemy:beast:slime-trail.name: Coat adjacent ground with green slime

enemy:beast:stalk.description: circles behind observed prey and waits beside doorways before peeking
enemy:beast:stalk.name: Stalk: circle behind and wait beside doorways

enemy:beast:venom-weak.description: inflicts stacking Envenomed on successful hits
enemy:beast:venom-weak.name: Weak Venom: 1 damage per stack for 5 turns

enemy:beast:venom.description: inflicts stacking Envenomed on successful hits
enemy:beast:venom.name: Venom: 2 damage per stack for 5 turns

enemy:beast:venom-strong.description: inflicts stacking Envenomed on successful hits
enemy:beast:venom-strong.name: Guardian Venom: 4 damage per stack for 5 turns

enemy:beast:detonate.description: can empty its entire energy reservoir in a nearby explosion
enemy:beast:detonate.name: Reservoir Explosion: all energy, radius 5, 50% of each victim's maximum HP (rounded up)

enemy:beast:horn-bolt.description: can strike nonadjacent prey with a magical bolt along a clear projectile path
enemy:beast:horn-bolt.name: Hornlight: ranged magical strike

enemy:beast:beckon.description: can teleport distant prey closer if a valid landing square is available
enemy:beast:beckon.name: Beckon: teleport prey closer

enemy:beast:wall-seal.description: can raise a temporary wall beside nearby prey when enough clear ground is available
enemy:beast:wall-seal.name: Stone Seal: raise a temporary wall

enemy:beast:rooted.description: is rooted in place and cannot make ordinary attacks
enemy:beast:rooted.name: Rooted: cannot move

enemy:beast:razorleaves.description: surrounds itself with razorleaves that damage exposed creatures at turn end
enemy:beast:razorleaves.name: Razorleaves: radius 5, 2% health at turn end

enemy:beast:everburn.name: Everburn: living flames never expire; with Fire Immunity, always burning

enemy:beast:aquatic.description: is restricted to shallow or deep water
enemy:beast:aquatic.name: Aquatic: lives in shallow or deep water

enemy:beast:submerge.description: hides underwater when it enters deep water
enemy:beast:submerge.name: Submerge: hide below water

enemy:beast:grab.description: can hold adjacent prey in place
enemy:beast:grab.name: Grasp: hold adjacent prey

enemy:beast:water-jet.description: can strike nonadjacent prey with a water jet and push it one tile away on a hit
enemy:beast:water-jet.name: Water Jet: damage and push

enemy:beast:blink.description: can teleport toward distant prey when a clear landing square is available
enemy:beast:blink.name: Moonstep: short-range teleport

enemy:beast:moon-laser.description: can charge a moonbeam, then fire it along a clear projectile path
enemy:beast:moon-laser.name: Moonbeam: charge then devastating laser

enemy:beast:hold-only.description: holds adjacent prey instead of making damaging ordinary attacks
enemy:beast:hold-only.name: Harmless: holds but never damages

enemy:beast:ruin-pulse.description: can unleash a burst that damages other nearby creatures within sight
enemy:beast:ruin-pulse.name: Ruin Pulse: destructive radius-three burst

enemy:beast:silence-aura.description: prevents nearby enemies within sight from activating energy-paid abilities
enemy:beast:silence-aura.name: Mouth of Silence: block new energy-paid activations within 3

enemy:beast:darkness-aura.description: darkens nearby ground, with walls blocking its aura
enemy:beast:darkness-aura.name: Darkness Aura: personal illumination -100; subtracts 100 minus 10 per orthogonal square, blocked by walls

enemy:pale:slow.description: acts only every other normal turn
enemy:pale:slow.name: Slow (acts every other turn)

enemy:pale:gas-immunity.description: is immune to caustic gas damage
enemy:pale:gas-immunity.name: Caustic Gas Immunity

enemy:pale:breath-boost.description: can exhale an additional cloud of caustic gas
enemy:pale:breath-boost.name: Forceful Exhalation

enemy:pale:gas-vulnerability.description: makes prey more vulnerable to caustic gas when its attacks deal damage
enemy:pale:gas-vulnerability.name: Caustic Wound

enemy:pale:bite-repeat.description: can follow a landed strike with another attack
enemy:pale:bite-repeat.name: Bite Again

enemy:pale:lifesteal.description: can heal itself after dealing damage
enemy:pale:lifesteal.name: Drink Life

enemy:pale:spit.description: can spit at nonadjacent prey along a clear projectile path, then spends an action recovering
enemy:pale:spit.name: Distant Spit

enemy:pale:gas-shot.description: can add caustic gas at its spit target
enemy:pale:gas-shot.name: Caustic Gas Shot

enemy:pale:scream.description: can weaken nearby foes, strengthen nearby allies and call allies to its location
enemy:pale:scream.name: Scream
